files.README.md:
Whinlatter Hatchery - fry counts

The board's counting program is kept here beside the tallies it reads and is
run over the folder each week by the biologist.
files.frytally.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Weekly fry tally - adds up the counts recorded in counts/
total=0
for f in counts/*.txt; do
  n=$(awk '{s+=$2} END {print s}' "$f")
  total=$((total+n))
done
echo "$total"
